items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: When Jerome Richardson was a kid we used to play in a lot of things together. ... Jerome played with me a lot of gigs.

ctx.x: And they’d have big artists, singers, and I’d have to furnish the bands. And one time they brought a band here and Nelson Riddle was involved with something so he brought Jerome Richardson. Did you ever hear of Jerome?
